code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points8=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==8]
    r0=min(r for r,c in points8); r1=max(r for r,c in points8)
    c0=min(c for r,c in points8); c1=max(c for r,c in points8)
    keypts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0,8)]
    kr0=min(r for r,c in keypts); kr1=max(r for r,c in keypts)
    kc0=min(c for r,c in keypts); kc1=max(c for r,c in keypts)
    key=[[grid[r][c] for c in range(kc0,kc1+1)] for r in range(kr0,kr1+1)]
    rot=[list(row) for row in zip(*key[::-1])]
    sh=(r1-r0+1)//len(rot); sw=(c1-c0+1)//len(rot[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in points8:
        i=(r-r0)//sh; j=(c-c0)//sw
        color=rot[i][j]
        if color==0:
            # Extend the nearest colored tile when the silhouette has a narrow overhang.
            candidates=[]
            for a,row in enumerate(rot):
                for b,v in enumerate(row):
                    if v:
                        candidates.append((abs(i-a)+abs(j-b), 0 if a==i else 1, abs(i-a), abs(j-b), v))
            color=min(candidates)[-1]
        out[r][c]=color
    return out
'''
